ChurchProfileOut.description:
GET /church: the active church and its profile. A superset of ChurchOut,
which the church list in GET /me keeps.
ChurchProfileOut.title: ChurchProfileOut

CreateChurchIn.description:
The body of POST /churches. A blank name, or a blank or unknown time
zone, passes this model and gets a 422 that names the field.
CreateChurchIn.title: CreateChurchIn

ErrorBody.description: Every error response's body (F §1.5). `fields` and `details` are left out when absent.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

InviteCodeIn.description: POST /invites/preview and /invites/accept: the code, only ever in the body (AC9).
InviteCodeIn.title: InviteCodeIn

InvitePreviewOut.description: What an invite offers. Never its id, code, church id, creator or bound email (F §7.4).
InvitePreviewOut.title: InvitePreviewOut

LectionaryOut.title: LectionaryOut

PassageOut.description: One ref as sent (trimmed), with every section, whatever loaded.
PassageOut.title: PassageOut

PassageSectionOut.description:
One " or " alternative: `ok` only when every part loaded; `text` joins the
parts that did, or is null when none did (S Status rules).
PassageSectionOut.title: PassageSectionOut

PassagesIn.description:
POST /scripture/passages. An empty list, a blank ref and more than 20
parts in all are the usecase's 422s, with its exact messages (S Schemas).
PassagesIn.title: PassagesIn

ReadingSetOut.description:
One set of readings. `scriptures` is in display order (first, psalm,
second, gospel) with compound cells split; the usecase guarantees 1-20
lines of 1-200 characters and a name of 1-300 (fits_draft_limits).
ReadingSetOut.title: ReadingSetOut

ScriptureMatchIn.description:
POST /hymns/scripture-matches. Refs blank after trimming are the usecase's
422 "Enter at least one scripture reference." (fields.refs).
ScriptureMatchIn.title: ScriptureMatchIn

TranslationsOut.description:
GET /translations: the translations this deployment offers, in display
order. "default" is "web"; "esv" is listed, last, only when it is configured.
TranslationsOut.title: TranslationsOut

get.description: Liveness: never touches the database. Railway's deploy health check is /health/ready (its Healthcheck Path setting).

Readiness (Railway's deploy health check and keepalive.yml): 503 db_unavailable
when, in production, the schema is behind this release, or when the database
is not reachable. `ahead`, `unknown` and an unset state (no lifespan) pass.

Ordered by hymnal, number (nulls last), title, id. `q` of 1-6 digits also
matches the number. An unknown hymnal is an empty page.

post.description: Join the invite's church; for an existing member, a 200 that changes nothing.
What the invite offers (church, role, expiry) without joining: writes nothing.

patch.description: Sparse update: send only what changes; null resets an item to its default.
